# santati_event_schema (Resource)

The current JSON Schema of one event action, managed as numbered schema versions. The action must already be defined in the event catalog. Use one `santati_event_schema` per action.

Changing a published document creates and publishes a new version, and the server deprecates the old one, which still accepts producers pinned to it until its deadline.

Published versions cannot be deleted: destroying this resource deletes an unpublished draft, but leaves a published version in force and only forgets it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "santati_event_schema" "invoice_voided" {
  action = "invoice.voided"
  schema = jsonencode({
    "$schema" = "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema"
    type      = "object"
    properties = {
      metadata = {
        type = "object"
        properties = {
          invoice_number = { type = "string" }
          void_reason    = { type = "string" }
        }
        required             = ["invoice_number"]
        additionalProperties = { type = "string" }
      }
    }
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `action` (String) The event action the schema applies to, e.g. `invoice.voided`. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `schema` (String) A JSON Schema 2020-12 document as a JSON object, usually built with `jsonencode(...)`. It validates the event's `metadata`, `actor.metadata` and each `targets[].metadata`, whose values are always strings. Every `$ref` must point inside the document. Key order and whitespace are ignored. The provider does no other validation; the control plane is the validator.

### Optional

- `publish` (Boolean) Publish the document so ingest validates against it. Defaults to `true`. With `false`, the document is kept as a draft that validates nothing and is edited in place. Setting it to `false` never unpublishes a version.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the tracked version was created.
- `deprecated_at` (String) When the tracked version was deprecated, or null.
- `deprecation_deadline` (String) Until when producers pinned to the tracked version are still accepted after it was deprecated, or null.
- `published_at` (String) When the tracked version was published, or null while it is a draft.
- `status` (String) The tracked version's status: `draft`, `published` or `deprecated`. A version becomes `deprecated` only when a newer version is published.
- `updated_at` (String) When the tracked version was last changed.
- `version` (Number) The schema version number this resource currently tracks. Numbers are never reused.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The version ingest currently validates against (newest published).
terraform import santati_event_schema.invoice_voided invoice.voided

# A specific version.
terraform import santati_event_schema.invoice_voided invoice.voided/3
```
